author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
I'm open as a scrim sub. I can rush. I know how to use TNT. I communicate well. I make strategies that actually involve the whole team doing something
Cons. I'm not incharge on when I have to leave. Skype is very laggy for me. Teamspeak is better for me.
